title: Lena and the Portrait
author: Zephyrine Almeida
blurb: Sable Okafor, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the statute expires.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
